sounds.title: 8 Cinematic Whoosh - @Sound Effect
sounds.annotation_basis: filename-derived tags; automated audio review; editorial usage recommendations

usage.intent: Cinematic motion and transitions
use_when: Fast camera moves, whip pans, or scene changes
Large title or logo entrances
usage.timing: The automated review places a drone in roughly the first six seconds and multiple sweeps afterward. Audition to select one sweep; start its lead-in before the movement and align its strongest part with the cut.
avoid_when: Do not drop the entire collection under one transition or use repeated loud sweeps beneath dialogue.
usage.example: A travel montage whip-pans from the street to a rooftop; one sweep bridges the cut.
usage.basis: editorial recommendation informed by automated audio review

audio_review.summary: A low drone at roughly the opening six seconds is followed by several sweeping whooshes and resonant impacts. No speech was identified; the overall tone was described as dark and dramatic.
audio_review.uncertainty: Automated descriptions and any approximate timestamps require audition before selecting exact cue boundaries.
